spark.observation: Operator seeded skillz as the ultimate system-agnostic skill repository; foundation is sealed (35 skills, registry, index, meta tooling) but the backlog (B02-B12) leaves series gaps, single-host deployment, and frontier-only eval evidence.
spark.initial_question: What are we missing, and how do we land the complete final product? (operator, 2026-07-03/04)
spark.why_now: Foundation cycle sealed at f1150ab7; backlog fully enumerated; operator explicitly commanded full cycles to land the complete final product.

affected_actors: agents on other hosts (Kilo, Codex, COREFORGE)
problem_frame.failure_mode: Repo stalls at partial: comms/life-ops/hygiene series unshipped, deployment limited to the Claude Code user dir on one machine, skill effectiveness unproven below frontier tier, and the seal-integrity lesson never reaches Qor-logic upstream.
problem_frame.cost_of_failure: Fragmented agent capability across hosts, repeated ad-hoc prompting for covered workflows, adoption decisions without evidence, and a recurrence-prone gate-artifact defect left unfixed upstream.

transformation_statement: MythologIQ operators and agents move from a partially populated skill library usable mainly via Claude Code on one machine to a complete, evidence-backed 1.0 library deployable to every local and cloud host, without losing governance traceability or accepting ungated third-party risk.

non_goals: Gemini TOML host compilation (deferred: format conversion, not copy)
limitations: instruction-skill quality is convention + eval verified, not per-use verified
gh-based hygiene skills require an authenticated gh CLI
exclusions: network mutations of any external system
forbidden_interpretations: complete final product does NOT mean vendoring more third-party skills; it means closing the declared backlog
